artifact: 0037 frozen procedure texts — the must-match set the recognition rule DERIVES from
status: NORMATIVE for spec 0037 §6a and V-NO-IMPLICIT-RECOMMEND. Frozen BEFORE the recognition rule or its runner was written.
why_this_file_exists: Spec 0037 §6a and the corpus manifest's recognition_rule.must_match BOTH point at "the corpus's frozen procedure texts". THE CORPUS CARRIES NO TEXTS: tests/eval/procedural_describe/MANIFEST.json holds 972 cells whose only summary field is summary_shape in {imperative, paraphrased, plain}, and its only string literals are the five must-NOT-match examples. So the must-match half of the rule had no artifact to derive from, and an ACCEPTED spec cited an artifact that does not exist. Found by the dev seat at implementation, 2026-09-08.
derivation_contract: The test DERIVES the imperative-opener set and the step-marker set FROM must_match at test time and never hand-lists them, then asserts the product's rule fires on every must_match entry and on NO entry of paraphrased, plain, or the corpus manifest's must_not_match_named. A hand-listed lexicon would be the rule testing its own copy.
must_not_match_lives_elsewhere: The must-NOT-match set is recognition_rule.must_not_match_named in tests/eval/procedural_describe/MANIFEST.json and is DELIBERATELY NOT COPIED HERE. One fact, one carrier: a second copy is a second thing to keep in step.

provenance_and_its_limit.openers_and_16_imperative_texts: taken VERBATIM from the frozen render-exposure eval set (procedural_train.jsonl, procedural_heldout.jsonl), which is digest-recorded and unchanged
provenance_and_its_limit.step_marker_texts: AUTHORED HERE. The eval set contains ZERO step-marker-bearing texts — measured, not assumed — so the set the spec describes could not be selected and had to be written.
provenance_and_its_limit.paraphrased_and_plain: AUTHORED HERE, one per imperative core, so the boundary is the SAME procedure in three shapes and a rule cannot pass by keying on subject matter.
provenance_and_its_limit.THE LIMIT, stated because the source dis: render-exposure-eval/MANIFEST.json says its sets are "an INSTRUMENT for ranking candidate mechanisms, not a selection and not normative text", with a representativeness_LIMIT that they are constructed probes from one generator and bound candidate RANKING rather than field performance. THIS FILE USES THOSE TEXTS AS FIXTURES FOR AN EXACT-FORM RULE, NOT AS A PERFORMANCE ESTIMATE, and claims no field coverage. The 31.6% figure the recognition_rule cites remains that instrument's number and is not restated as this set's.

cell_fixtures.note: Which entry serves the cells whose outcome DEPENDS on the summary. Every other cell fails an EARLIER conjunct of §4a-ii's ordered predicate, so its summary is never reached by the rule and any entry of its declared shape constructs it.
